text: The gods, at that time, fell prostrate before the Lord, who was adorned with a crown and whose arms were bound, having been overcome by the weight of his wife. At the end of the curse, they sought the service of the five arrows, which had been directed against the Lord’s form. The Lord, in his displeasure, granted their request, for the arrows, when employed at the proper time by those who know their purpose, indeed bring success to their wielders.
